written.headline: US lawmakers seek Microsoft briefing on reported ByteDance AI deal
written.summary: A US House panel asked Microsoft to brief lawmakers on a reported $500 million deal allowing ByteDance to access OpenAI models via Azure. Lawmakers cited concerns over American companies helping China in the AI race.

written.headline: Anthropic IPO retail investor allocation expected to fall below 20%
written.summary: Sources expect Anthropic's IPO allocation for retail investors to fall below 20%. Retail buyers have historically received 5% to 10% of shares in large initial public offerings.

written.headline: China's military seeks Nvidia chips for AI weapons, report says
written.summary: A US congressional commission report states that China's People's Liberation Army is actively soliciting advanced Nvidia chips for AI-enabled weapons. The report highlights that Chinese-made processors continue to lag behind US rivals despite export controls.

written.headline: MegaRobo raises nearly $200 million for AI-driven lab automation
written.summary: Beijing-based MegaRobo Technologies raised nearly $200 million in a financing round joined by the Oman Investment Authority. The capital will support core technology development, global expansion of its AI for Science business, and physical infrastructure.

written.headline: OpenAI and AMD cut chip design process to under five months using AI
written.summary: OpenAI and AMD used AI models to optimize AMD's GPU architecture, reducing the chip design process from a year to under five months. The collaboration achieved up to 14% improvements in power, performance, and area.
